method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, conditional-branch inspection, macro/token comparison and reverse paraphrase with established native terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: Proof-systems chapter driver, its FOL/PL title branches, editorial reuse guidance, and five survey-section imports.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Whether the FOL tag is true or false, the chapter is titled Derivation Systems; only the unchanged chapter namespace differs between the two branches.
samples.checks: Both conditional branches, chapter identifiers, the derivation token, and the plural system heading are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The chapter gathers general material about derivation systems. A textbook that uses a particular system may place the introduction and the relevant survey section at the start of the chapter that introduces that system.
samples.checks: The permission, the specific-system restriction, both sections, and their placement at the beginning of the introducing chapter are unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The driver imports the introduction, sequent-calculus, natural-deduction, tableaux, and axiomatic-deduction surveys in the source order.
samples.checks: All five import targets and their order are byte-identical to the source.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
The established compounds निष्पत्ती पद्धती and सिद्धता-पद्धती remain open to specialist preference review.
